paragraph: In 1994, a teenager named David vacationed on the Greek island of Kos with his family. He joined a group of twelve children from different families. Among them was a fifteen-year-old girl named Jodie. This group of kids became a friendly pack during their week together. David and Jodie started a pen pal relationship that lasted decades.
